note:
2321 -> 2320. The floor was wrong when it was committed, not repaid since.

1fcc3d5f7d2 banked 2321, and its note already recorded a discrepancy it could not place: 'HEAD is separately 1 violation above its own floor of 2454; that one is not absorbed here.' The tree measured 2320. Same window, same mechanism as lint_xml_unformatted.

Verified by measuring /test_lint at the CI scope (--addons-path=odoo/addons,addons, -i test_lint alone) in a git-archive tree at each of 4f9e7bc4829, 1fcc3d5f7d2, 3e2cea4c580, d61d3cbf107, 5c4807329df, 2ae263169a4, f57cbefef48 and HEAD. All eight measure the same number, so nothing was repaid in between: the floor was never true of the tree it was committed to.
